svg.title: 10-byte bzip2: Pseudorandom proxy sample (not a census)
svg.desc: Two histograms of original size divided by compressed size; higher is better. Whole stream and outer-framing-excluded payload. Counts do not represent all 2^80 inputs.
svg.text: Pseudorandom proxy sample (not a census) | n = 3,145,728
Higher ratios are better; values below 1 mean expansion. Payload retains internal block headers, CRC, tables and controls.
The exact period-divides-2 family is separate from the proxy sample; neither is the full 2^80-input distribution.
